_about: Combat, survival and AI tuning. Distances in metres, times in ms.

downed._about: At 0 HP you go down instead of dying while a crewmate is online and up. Enemy fire drains bleedHp; at 0, or after bleedOutMs, you die. Solo players (no crewmate online) also go down if they carry a medkit, and can patch themselves up (selfReviveMs, uses the medkit) once per selfReviveCooldownMs.

optics._about: thermalRange: how far a thermal sight picks out people and animals (and sees through optical camo) while you aim. glintRange: how far away a 12x lens flash shows.

newPlayerShield._about: Below untilLevel, other players can't hurt, stun, take down or hack you, until you attack a player or someone's base (that ends it for good). Your claim marker and tools never drop when you die, at any level.
